title: 第一卷 第1章 生死一线
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“嗯……好烫……”

景阳宫内，婉贵妃苏清婉意识模糊地呢喃，往日冷艳的容颜此刻苍白，几缕被冷汗浸透的发丝黏在脸颊。

她身上华贵的赤金凤袍因痛苦而凌乱，领口滑落，露出一片泛着异常潮红的肌肤。

叶笙歌跪在榻前，双手按压在她心口下方，而她的身体却在不住轻颤。

“娘娘再忍片刻。”叶笙歌低着头，用宫里太监特有的温顺腔调说道，手下力道精准。

就在片刻前，他还是现代一名出色的内科医生，再睁眼，竟已穿成大夏皇宫里一个叫叶笙歌的小太监，且还是个“假太监”！

更致命的是，他刚穿越，就面临着死局。

尚膳监总管赵公公刻意讨好婉贵妃，精心熬制了一味大补纯阳的龙凤呈祥汤。

谁料苏清婉只喝了一口，便猛地呕出鲜血，四肢僵硬抽搐，当场昏迷不醒。

皇帝震怒，认定有人下毒，尚膳监所有宫人即刻杖杀。叶笙歌已被拖到殿外，刀锋抵颈。

千钧一发，他只能嘶声喊道：“陛下开恩！奴才或许能救贵妃！”

“放肆！一个低贱杂役，也敢触碰贵妃凤体！”一个老太监尖声呵斥，上前就要拽开他。

“住手！”

龙椅上的皇帝蓦然起身，脸色阴沉，目光钉在叶笙歌身上：“让他治！若是救不回来，朕将他凌迟处死，尚膳监所有人一同陪葬！”

皇帝准许他为婉贵妃施治，便有了方才那一幕。

殿内死寂。

叶笙歌后背被冷汗浸透，已无退路。

他强迫自己冷静，快速观察贵妇的症状——呕血暗沉，手指痉挛……这根本不是中毒！

“陛下，诸位太医大人，”他尽量让声音平稳，“贵妃娘娘此症，并非中毒，乃是虚不受补，汤药性烈，与娘娘体内旧疾寒毒猛然相冲所致！”

“荒谬！”为首的太医院院正周仲景立刻驳斥，“贵妃分明是中毒之兆！你一个阉奴懂什么医术，在此信口雌黄！”

Page (1/3)

"Hmm... so hot..."

In Jingyang Palace, Concubine Wan Su Qingwan murmured vaguely. Her formerly cold face was now pale, with a few strands of hair soaked in cold sweat sticking to her cheeks.

The luxurious red gold phoenix robe on her body was messy due to pain, and the collar slipped down, revealing a piece of skin that was extremely flushed.

Ye Shengge knelt in front of the couch and pressed his hands under her heart, but her body couldn't help but tremble.

"Your Majesty, please bear with me for a moment longer." Ye Shengge lowered his head and said in the gentle tone unique to a palace eunuch, using precise force.

Just a moment ago, he was an outstanding modern physician. When he opened his eyes again, he was actually a young eunuch named Ye Shengge in the Great Xia Palace, and he was also a "fake eunuch"!

What's even more fatal is that as soon as he crossed over, he faced a dead end.

Eunuch Zhao, the director of the Shangshan Restaurant, deliberately cooked up Longfeng Chengxiang Soup, a soup that greatly replenished pure yang, to please Concubine Wan.

Unexpectedly, Su Qingwan only took a sip before she suddenly vomited blood, her limbs stiffened and twitched, and she fell unconscious on the spot.

The emperor was furious and believed that someone had poisoned him. All the palace officials in Shangshan Prison were immediately executed with sticks.Ye Shengge had been dragged outside the palace, with the knife pointed at his neck.

At the critical moment, he could only shout: "Your Majesty, have mercy! Maybe this slave can save the noble concubine!"

"How presumptuous! How dare a lowly servant touch the body of a noble concubine!" An old eunuch scolded in a sharp voice and stepped forward to pull him away.

"Stop!"

The emperor on the dragon throne suddenly stood up, his face gloomy, his eyes fixed on Ye Shengge: "Let him be cured! If he cannot be saved, I will execute him in Lingchi, and everyone in Shangshan Prison will be buried with him!"

The emperor allowed him to treat Concubine Wan, which led to the scene just now.

There was dead silence in the palace.

Ye Shengge's back was soaked with cold sweat, and there was no way out.

He forced himself to calm down and quickly observed the lady's symptoms - dull blood vomiting, finger spasms... This was not poisoning at all!

"Your Majesty, gentlemen of the imperial family," he tried to keep his voice as steady as possible, "the disease suffered by the imperial concubine is not caused by poisoning, but caused by deficiency due to lack of supplementation, the strong nature of the decoction, and the sudden conflict with the old cold and cold poison in the imperial concubine's body!"

"Absurd!" Zhou Zhongjing, the head of the imperial hospital, immediately refuted it, "The imperial concubine is clearly a sign of poisoning! What kind of medical skills do you, an eunuch, know? You are talking nonsense here!"
